query: The Regulars' Corner The regulars' corner has never had a round bought by staff. The landlady says that's exactly why you should. "Nobody listens to a story from someone who's never stood them a drink." Stand the corner a round The corner raises the mugs to you, by name, which you didn't know they knew. For the rest of the night they call you over to settle every argument. Keep your tips You pocket your tips. The corner doesn't notice either way, which is rather the point.
